title: Nihaya cumulative adopted textual decisions through Stage X
countingPolicy: One decision is one adopted editorial issue. A single relation-predicate decision in VI.16 requires two string replacements. Spacing repairs are counted separately. source.laterEdition: 1428 AH revised edition, edited by ʿAbbās ʿAlī al-Zāriʿī

decisions.reason: Here the subjects are the impossibility of quiddity and the impossibility of possibility, so they amount to denying the nullification of intrinsic necessity. Earlier A18 instead concerns the impossible attributes themselves and correctly reduces them to denial of necessity. Preserves that crucial change of negative scope.
